subject: Publishing Interactive R Visualizations to Secure Environment

messages.author: 31f2a4a0c7dcca4a
messages.subject: Publishing Interactive R Visualizations to Secure Environment
parts:
Hi All - I'm looking for a solution to disseminate visualizations created in R that will be (1) be using proprietary data and (2) needs to be accessed by a client.  Can someone provide any information on how to achieve this or direct me to articles that explain it?  They have a small budget and will only need to access the completed visualizations, and hopefully we can provide them visualizations that are interactive (filtering, etc.).
Thank you,
Cindy
